decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through contacts draw directly on the firm's core drilling, structuring and bonding know-how, and its in-house R&D lets it keep refining them for MEMS packaging customers.

The Cu-interposer glass wafer is a flagship that extends the firm's glass structuring competence into advanced packaging, a growing field where its R&D and EU project experience help it learn from early customer results.
The Wafer Universe off-the-shelf brand sits very close to the firm's established standard glass and quartz wafer business, so it needs little new knowledge and is easy to sustain and assess.

Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the firm's substrate expertise, which makes early results harder to interpret, but the related glass-via and interposer knowledge offers some absorptive base, so keeping it under close review is justified for now.
